notes.title: DLC.1 free patch ✨ (this special benefit has terminated)
notes.notes:
The Early Access version you purchased,
already contain DLC.1 which will be sold separately at the time of main release.
You will need to register your activation with this patch.

Procedure:
(1) update to the latest version v2.6.1~.
(2) Start up the game and enter Story or Traveling mode.
(3) Go back to the Main menu, then you will see a pink "DLC1" sign on the right.

Please do this by the end of February 2024.
(*this special benefit has terminated.)

Other
* Contents refined
✨ 'Full screen' / 'Window screen' via the Inventory Settings

notes.title: Memory 6 ability "LedgeHang" (Update v2.5.4+)
notes.notes:
if you missed the Memory 6 ability "LedgeHang" and clear the stage, couldn't proceed Story mode.
[Fixed] it will automatically can use the ability now.
Jump to wall hook(Sun-Moon/L icon), it will automatically grab it.

After Memory 7, you can go down in the Story Tree. 
After Memory 11, go down more.
